items.title: Police investigate Married at First Sight Australia after 'inappropriate' allegations
items.description: New South Wales Police say inquiries took place "following a report of inappropriate content being shared".

items.title: At least four dead after storm brings flooding to southern France
items.description: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.

items.title: French weekend protests to be limited to union demos only, says Macron
items.description: Some cities including Lyon and Nice have banned all protests, and the French president said only authorised demos would be allowed.

items.title: Two European women held captive for more than a year in Niger freed in Libya
items.description: The Swiss government told the BBC that the freed national was on her way back to Switzerland.

items.title: Teacher in Oregon shooting said she pretended to be dead to survive
items.description: The teacher said she could not help children because she was badly injured by the attacker.

items.title: Two killed in Houthi attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
items.description: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement targeting airports and other sites in the kingdom.

items.title: Ilhan Omar says 'bizarre' pre-dawn raid on her home is forcing her to move out
items.description: The congresswoman said federal agents seized over a dozen items, including cell phones and notebooks, as part of a federal investigation.
